cohort: 17,495 female veterans who gave birth in California between 2000 and 2012
finding: Veterans who relied on VA health coverage had higher rates of preeclampsia, cesarean births, and a trend toward more NICU admissions compared to Veterans using other (non-Medicaid) coverage.
mod_finding: Veterans using VA coverage had a higher rate of cesarean births compared to Veterans using other (non-Medicaid) coverage.
